column3: “With whom you found pleasure” reverses the direction of being pleasing to the lovers.
“Lovers” supplies the referent of “their”; “jewelry” narrows the beautiful articles.
“Your lovers” supplies the recipients of payment.
North and south interpret left and right.
“As you have seen” replaces “when I saw.”
The captivity of your captives is shortened to restoring you.
“An object of scorn” specifies the mention in your mouth.
“Consequences” interprets bearing the lewdness and abominations.
